name: List All Tenant Ledgers
description: Returns all tenant ledgers that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Unique identifier of the property. All requests must include this filter.

queryFilters.name: filters[DateFrom]
queryFilters.description: Start date for the ledger date range filter. All requests must include this filter.

queryFilters.name: filters[DateTo]
queryFilters.description: End date for the ledger date range filter. All requests must include this filter.

queryFilters.name: filters[OccupancyId]
queryFilters.description: Unique identifier of the occupancy to filter ledgers by.

queryFilters.name: filters[ExcludeSubsidies]
queryFilters.description: When true, excludes subsidy entries from the ledger results.

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Number of results per page. Default is 1000.

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the occupancy associated with the ledger

responseFields.name: data[].Ledger
responseFields.description: Array of ledger data. Contains the charges, payments, and credits for the occupancy specified by the OccupancyId.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
